observed_behavior: The runtime combined configuration dispatch, lifecycle validation, event serialization, and transaction start work in long functions; a private transaction structure had too many independently tracked fields; and HTTP request parsing used mutable pointers for read-only data. PR #216 remediated the applicable changed code without a new Sonar issue, but resulting master still reproduces the historical cognitive-complexity finding in load_runtime_config.
observed_behavior_de: Die Runtime vereinte Konfigurations-Dispatch, Lifecycle-Validierung, Event-Serialisierung und Transaction-Start-Arbeit in langen Funktionen; eine private Transaction-Struktur besaß zu viele unabhängig verfolgte Felder; und HTTP-Request-Parsing verwendete veränderbare Pointer für schreibgeschützte Daten. PR #216 remedierte den anwendbaren geänderten Code ohne neues Sonar-Issue, aber der Resulting-Master reproduziert weiterhin den historischen Cognitive-Complexity-Befund in load_runtime_config.
expected_behavior: The Common Runtime must preserve configuration interpretation, body-limit decisions, native ModSecurity phase order, request/response enforcement, decision-event fields and integrity chaining, and HTTP parsing behavior while the affected functions meet Sonar maintainability thresholds.
expected_behavior_de: Die Common Runtime muss Konfigurationsinterpretation, Body-Limit-Entscheidungen, native ModSecurity-Phase-Reihenfolge, Request-/Response-Enforcement, Decision-Event-Felder und Integrity-Chaining sowie HTTP-Parsing-Verhalten bewahren, während die betroffenen Funktionen Sonars Maintainability-Grenzen einhalten.
impact: These are confirmed maintainability findings, not evidenced security vulnerabilities. The affected code processes HTTP input and ModSecurity enforcement state, so a mistaken refactor could affect policy application or recorded evidence. PR #221 has focused C17 and contract evidence, a complete security-diff review with zero reportable findings, and a clean exact-head hosted Sonar result; direct resulting-master verification remains the only condition before verified or closed.
impact_de: Dies sind bestätigte Maintainability-Befunde, keine belegten Security-Vulnerabilities. Der betroffene Code verarbeitet HTTP-Eingaben und ModSecurity-Enforcement-State, daher könnte ein fehlerhafter Refactor Policy-Anwendung oder aufgezeichnete Evidenz beeinflussen. root_cause: Configuration, validation, event construction, and transaction-start responsibilities accumulated in a few lifecycle functions, while private state used separate fields for cohesive metadata and body-progress groups. Read-only HTTP parsing values were not declared const. The remaining historical issue is the still branch-dense load_runtime_config parser.
root_cause_de: Konfiguration, Validierung, Event-Konstruktion und Transaction-Start-Verantwortlichkeiten sammelten sich in wenigen Lifecycle-Funktionen, während privater State separate Felder für zusammenhängende Metadata- und Body-Progress-Gruppen verwendete. Schreibgeschützte HTTP-Parsing-Werte waren nicht als const deklariert. Der verbleibende historische Befund ist der weiterhin branch-dichte load_runtime_config-Parser.
proposed_remediation: Refactor only the two affected Parent Common Runtime C sources and the direct SDK source-contract test; group cohesive private state, extract narrowly named helpers, use const-correct parsing pointers, and retain the bilingual Change Record. A follow-up must additionally decompose load_runtime_config while preserving line-numbered parser errors and file-close behavior. Do not change Sonar rules, Quality Gates, exclusions, suppressions, NOSONAR, Framework/MRTS source, Gitlinks, or master.
